data.long_meaning: Mansa is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'man' which means 'mind' or 'intellect'. The name Mansa signifies the embodiment of desire and willpower. It is believed that a person named Mansa is strong-willed, determined, and focused. The name Mansa carries the meaning “Desire, Will” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mansa usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, will and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of the mind and will to manifest one's desires.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mansa total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
